description: The file is a Python test script that automates disabling the WebConfig RFC and verifying the change by checking logs. It uses the TDK library to interact with system parameters and execute shell commands for log verification.

classes.name: TDKScriptingLibrary
classes.description: A class provided by the TDK library for scripting test cases, enabling module loading, configuration, and test step execution.

methods.name: getLoadModuleResult
methods.description: Checks whether the module was successfully loaded.

methods.name: setLoadModuleStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of module loading to success or failure.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step object for executing specific test commands.

methods.name: addParameter
methods.description: Adds parameters for the test step, such as parameter names and values.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Executes the test case on the DUT.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result status after executing a test step.

methods.name: getResultDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed output or logs from the test execution.

methods.name: setResultStatus
methods.description: Marks the test step as success or failure.

methods.name: unloadModule
methods.description: Unloads the specified module after test execution.
